notes.title: Patch Update Game Version 1.0.1.0
notes.notes:
-Reduced Stroke Beam advancement rate

-Now when player collides with a Protein Block the Protein Block will align again

-Added an extra frame of animation to each regular Boss

-Adjusted happenings when Bosses are defeated

-Slightly reduced Doomer spawn rates 

-remedied issue if player may happen to get stuck near the very top or bottom of the screen

-Fixed issue where a certain Text Prompt did not show on the Probe Complete Screen

-Fixed Bug in the game ending stat screen where the time and player hit count did not show on screen

-Added a "Made for 1080p and lower 16:9 aspect ratio resolutions" notice for the notice screen

-Added two more tips for the tip randomizer to explain what the Flow State does and mention how the Player Probe enlarges when each wave is cleared

notes.title: Gameplay Balancing Adjustments | Game Version 1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
-Procedural Generation Balance and wave trigger adjustments

-Added Counter reset for endurance count

-Spawn Rate adjustments
